metaphors.title: The price of a nice dinner
metaphors.paraphrase: Some basic questions can now be resolved for the marginal cost of a nice dinner, and we should be delighted.

metaphors.title: Monkey enumerating ZFC
metaphors.paraphrase: A computer or monkey applying deduction rules from the axioms shows proving theorems is not the goal.

metaphors.title: Conjecture falling in the woods
metaphors.paraphrase: If a conjecture falls in the woods and no one hears it, who cares?
